역대상 3:1.content: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

역대상 3:2.content: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

역대상 3:3.content: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

역대상 3:4.content: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

역대상 3:5.content: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath–shua the daughter of Ammiel:

역대상 3:6.content: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

역대상 3:7.content: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

역대상 3:8.content: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

역대상 3:9.content: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

역대상 3:10.content: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

역대상 3:11.content: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

역대상 3:12.content: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

역대상 3:13.content: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

역대상 3:14.content: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

역대상 3:15.content: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

역대상 3:16.content: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

역대상 3:17.content: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

역대상 3:18.content: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

역대상 3:19.content: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

역대상 3:20.content: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab–hesed, five.

역대상 3:21.content: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

역대상 3:22.content: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

역대상 3:23.content: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

역대상 3:24.content: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
